_comment: Phase 214-04 gate 214-F fixture (the SEED-049 D10 acceptance, the falsifier for the DG-3 per-field-cosine choice). Four candidates whose SAPPhIRE encodings share EXACTLY the rubric's layer set for their qualitative_label with the source: surface = state_change only; behavioral = state_change+action+phenomenon (BEHAVIORAL_SET); structural = +real_effect (STRUCTURAL_SET); deep = all seven. Shared layers carry the source string verbatim (offline stub -> cosine 1.0 -> corresponds); non-shared layers are left empty so they never correspond. stub_text_cosine is 1.0 for all four (constant Leg 1) so that fused strictly increases with the structural leg alone - the measured band must equal the hand label and fused must rise surface < behavioral < structural < deep.
